title: Falling sand
description: The GPU steps sand, water, lava, wood and crystal cell by cell. Lava, fire, crystals and particle embers light the cave through @typegpu/radiance-cascades. Water tints the light, and walls and steam reflect it. Crystals dim as sand buries them. Bloom adds glow, and events count cooled lava and burning wood.
line: Sand, water and lava falling cell by cell through a cave lit by its own glow.
hint: drag to paint · choose a material in the panel
